errors.evidence: The machine-generated description states the chart shows the "Anzahl von Personen" (number of people), but omits the key term "Entlastete" (relieved/benefited) from the y-axis label, which is central to the chart's purpose.

errors.text_span: Es werden drei blaue Balken dargestellt.
errors.evidence: The chart clearly displays six blue bars, not three. This statement contradicts the visual evidence and the subsequent enumeration of categories.

errors.text_span: Der Balken für die Kategorie „60 – <80“ hat eine Höhe, die ungefähr 940 Personen entspricht.
errors.evidence: The bar for the category "60 - <80" has a value of 1,110 according to the data label on the chart, not 940. The value 940 corresponds to the "80 - <100" category.

errors.text_span: Der Balken für die Kategorie „80 – <100“ hat eine Höhe, die ungefähr 200 Personen entspricht.
errors.evidence: The bar for the category "80 - <100" has a value of 940, not 200. The value 200 corresponds to the "100 - <200" category.

errors.text_span: Der Balken für die Kategorie „100 – <200“ hat eine Höhe, die ungefähr 20 Personen entspricht.
errors.evidence: The bar for the category "100 - <200" has a value of 200, not 20. The value 20 corresponds to the ">= 200" category.
The description fails to mention the bar for the income category ">= 200", which has a value of 20. It only provides values for five of the six categories shown.
